selected_texts: Since co-regulation was suggested between PlaR and KdgR, we also examined transcription level of the PlaR-target genes in the absence of KdgR by using Northern blot analysis. In the absence of KdgR, transcription increased for the eda, kdgT, kdgK and kduD genes, which were the known targets of KdgR. In addition, the increase of mRNA was also observed for the glpT and glpA gene (Fig. 5 , compare lanes 1 and 3), implying the novel targets of KdgR. It is noteworthy that the level of plaR mRNA significantly increased in the absence of KdgR whereas kdgR mRNA increased in the absence of PlaR. This finding suggests a regulatory interplay between the two transcription factors, PlaR and KdgR.
record_assertion: Northern blots show increased plaR mRNA after deletion of KdgR, supporting a negative influence on plaR expression under these conditions. Regulation may be indirect; direct promoter binding is not established.

selected_texts: Influence of PlaR on transcription of the regulatory target genes. E. coli wild-type BW25113 (lane 1) and its plaR -defective mutant (lane 2) and kdgR -defective mutant (lane 3) were grown in M9-casamino acids (0.5%) medium at 37 °C with shaking under aerobic conditions. In the middle of exponential phase, total RNA was extracted from each culture and subjected to Northern blot analysis. DIG-labelled hybridization probes are shown on the left side of each panel. The amounts of total RNA analyzed were determined by measuring the intensity of ribosomal RNAs.
record_assertion: Figure 5 compares BW25113 with plaR- and kdgR-defective derivatives in M9 plus 0.5% casamino acids, 37 C, aerobic shaking; RNA was sampled at mid-exponential phase for Northern blots.

selected_texts: E. coli DH5α was used for plasmid amplification. E. coli BL21 (DE3) was used for PlaR expression and purification. E. coli K-12 W3110 type-A for genome DNA segments used for gSELEX. E. coli K-12 BW25113 52 and its single-gene deletion mutants, JW3546 ( plaR ) and JW1816 ( kdgR ) 53 , were obtained from the E. coli Stock Center (National Bio-Resource Center) for the assays of cell growth, promoter activity and Northern blotting. JW3546 lacking a Km marker was constructed in this study. Cells were grown in LB or M9 minimal media with supplemented 0.2% of galacturonate or 0.5% of Casamino acids at 37 °C under aeration with constant shaking at 150 r.p.m. When necessary, 20 μg ml −1 kanamycin was added into the medium. Cell growth was monitored by measuring the turbidity at 600 nm.
record_assertion: Methods identify BW25113, JW3546 (plaR deletion) and JW1816 (kdgR deletion) for Northern blots. The K-12 protein and MG1655 gene accessions provide reference identities; the reported experiment used these BW25113 derivatives.
The issuing K-12 protein record links kdgR protein P76268 to NCBI Gene 946129; the protein identity is distinct from the measured gene-expression target.
